summary: Interim status quo order in second appeal under Section 100 CPC; no substantial question of law framed; reliance on Ram Phal v. Banarasi; revenue records not proof of title; Bhimabai Mahadeo Kambekar cited; inherent power under Section 151 CPC invoked; ad interim measure to preserve subject matter; distinguishable from stay of decree; order upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 O.41 R.5
Andhra Pradesh Urban Areas (Development) Act, 1975 s.14
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; impugned interim order upheld; status quo maintained.
